hypothesis: A bounded directed import chain from explicit compiler coordinates adds relevant change evidence beyond direct file history.

decision.commit_purpose: Validated capability reproduction and negative evidence, not a passing retrieval optimization

results.case_without_coordinates_policy: Retain explicit empty controls without projecting an irrelevant snapshot

diagnosis.dispatcher_source: The archived Git blob contains an include guard and conditional includes for x86, POWER9 and ARM headers.
diagnosis.archived_graph_query: Both File-qualified-name and whole-file outgoing queries return only DEFINES relationships for the dispatcher; the architecture header nodes themselves exist.
diagnosis.source_behavior: The cursor visits only root children and next siblings; it does not descend into preprocessor conditional or include-guard nodes.
diagnosis.scope_of_proof: A fresh full index of the pinned binary reproduces missing nested includes independently of historical archive construction. This does not identify every historical build's executable.
diagnosis.required_cbm_change: Extract nested C/C++ static include possibilities, preserve target identity and source locations, and distinguish conditional reachability from active build configuration. Add full-index regressions for include guards and preprocessor branches.

gates.native_path_tests: A separate hand-authored graph verifies direction, edge types, parallel aliases, exact path depth and truncation in the actual CBM query engine.

limitations: Only one development case contains usable native compiler coordinates; it cannot establish general effectiveness of import-path retrieval.
An empty graph query is not negative evidence of dependency absence. Successful parse and row round-trip do not establish semantic indexing completeness.
The capability gate intentionally fails on the pinned CBM. No missing edge was injected into the source archive or retrieval results.
No C changes, upstream source writes, all-history reindexing, agent runs or pushes.

next.candidate_combination: Round-robin in the registered lane order, with exact thread deduplication and at most 100 source candidates per lane
controls: primary lexical RRF at identical unique-thread budgets
best individual lexical arm as an explicitly oracle control
next.unchanged_parameters: Primary-diagnostic extraction, lexical arm construction and RRF constant, fixed version horizon, file-history semantics and temporal ranking remain those of R001-R003.
next.report: Per-case known-reference ranks, merged/proposal distinctions, applicability, unresolved evidence and cold cost; no exhaustive-recall or fix-success claim
next.held_out_policy: No parameter changes after held-out retrieval begins. Failures inform a subsequent development round, not retroactive checkpoint tuning.
next.blindness_limit: The source catalog and some inputs were inspected during the initial audit; this is held-out retrieval evaluation, not a fully blinded study.
